en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a rural scene on a rocky island landscape. In the foreground a man in traditional clothing stands beside two loaded pack animals (likely donkeys or mules) on a dirt road. In the background, white houses of a hillside town are visible. The card is framed with printed Greek and French text and bears a round stamp-like emblem and a small serial number at the bottom.
